Source: Southeastern Louisiana University  2025-2026 General Catalog (official online catalog), program page 'Health Sciences, BS'.
Transcribed from the catalog's official semester-by-semester sequence via an archived copy (live catalog behind bot protection); live program URL: https://catalog.southeastern.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=5&poid=1826&returnto=155
Semester 1: catalog states 15-17 SCH; transcribed 15 SCH using first-listed options.
Semester 8 HS 4100: catalog lists 3-6 SCH; transcribed at 6 SCH (chosen to reconcile with the catalog's stated semester total).
Catalog states program total 120-122 SCH; transcribed plan sums to 120 SCH using first-listed options.
